tagline: Your notes, turned into something you can practice.
brief: A study app transforms course material into flashcards and quizzes, helping students practice rather than reread.
promise: Turn passive notes into active practice
question: How do you make a study app useful before you explain its features?
overview: The references make the student’s frustration visible, then demonstrate a change of behavior: notes become questions, a confusing concept becomes a practice set, and the interface proves the promise.
searchNotes: A second domain to verify that the research is not tied to travel.
WPS visibly shows flashcard creation at 48.8 seconds.
The sources do not establish long-term learning outcomes or spaced-repetition effectiveness.

references.creator: degrasya77
references.caption: POV: I found a study routine that finally helps me understand difficult topics. 📚✨ #GauthPhilippines #Gauth  #fyp #relatable #viral
references.transcript: I've been studying for hours but I still don't get this concept. No matter how many times I read it, it just won't stick. And the exam is right around the corner. I don't want to memorize it, I actually want to understand it. So I decided to give Goth a try. I just snapped a photo and it instantly explained the whole concept. And now it really makes sense. And if I'm so confused, I can just ask a live tutor. It's like having a teacher write time aside who I can ask questions at any time. Then I use the practice questions generated by Quizify to check if I've mastered the concept. And this way I'll know if I've truly learned it, instead of just memorizing it. And I feel so much more confident whenever I study now. Instead of getting stuck on a single point and wasting hours, I can keep moving forward while truly understanding each topic. If you're preparing for quizzes, finals, or even entrance exams, finding the routine that helps you understand the materials makes all the difference. And for me, that's God. I'm going to be able to do that.

angles.title: Recognize the study spiral.
angles.label: FAMILIAR FRUSTRATION
angles.description: Start with the moment when more reading stops helping.
angles.whyItFits: The user needs a better way to practice, not another place to store notes.
angles.evidence: Gauth opens on hours of studying without understanding. WPS shows schoolwork overload.
angles.suggestedHook: You’ve read the same page five times. Now what?
angles.visualDirection: Repeated highlighting, an approaching exam, then one concrete practice question.

angles.title: Show notes becoming questions.
angles.label: PRODUCT PROOF
angles.description: Make the transformation happen on screen and let the viewer try answering.
angles.whyItFits: The output explains a flashcard app more clearly than a list of AI features.
angles.evidence: WPS shows notes converted to flashcards. Gemini shows class material turned into a custom quiz.
angles.suggestedHook: Don’t reread your notes. Make them ask you questions.
angles.visualDirection: A page of notes becomes a flashcard. Pause before revealing the answer.
